sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use different prepositions to talk about time.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz dˈɪfəɹənt pɹˌɛpəzˈɪʃᵊnz tə tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 我们用不同的预设来谈论时间。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We read English in the morning.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː ɹˈɛd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪn ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our new term starts in September.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə njˈuː tˈɜːm stˈɑːts ɪn sɛptˈɛmbə./
sentences.meaning: 我们的新任期从9月开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a field trip in autumn.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hav ɐ fˈiːld tɹˈɪp ɪn ˈɔːtəm./
sentences.meaning: 我们秋天有一次实地考察

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We took a trip to a farm in 2022.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː tˈʊk ɐ tɹˈɪp tə ɐ fˈɑːm ɪn twˈɛnti twˈɛnti tˈuː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We don’t go to school on Saturday.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː dˈəʊnt ɡˌəʊ tə skˈuːl ˌɒn sˈatədeɪ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our summer holiday starts on 1 July.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə sˈʌmə hˈɒlɪdeɪ stˈɑːts ˌɒn wˈʌn ʤʊlˈaɪ./
sentences.meaning: 我们的暑假从7月1日开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a Biology class on Tuesday morning.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hav ɐ baɪˈɒləʤi klˈɑːs ˌɒn tjˈuːzdeɪ mˈɔːnɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 星期二早上我们有个生物学课

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have lots of fun on Children’s Day.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hav lˈɒts ɒv fˈʌn ˌɒn ʧˈɪldɹᵊnz dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 我们儿童节有很多乐趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie often gets up at 7 o’clock.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪli ˈɒfᵊn ɡɛts ˌʌp at sˈɛvᵊn əklˈɒk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Children in China usually start school at 6 years old.
sentences.ipa: /ʧˈɪldɹᵊn ɪn ʧˈaɪnə jˈuːʒʊəli stˈɑːt skˈuːl at sˈɪks jˈɪəz ˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 中国儿童通常6岁开始上学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A1 Sandy is talking to her grandma about her school life.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪ wˈʌn sˈandi ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɜː ɡɹˈandmɑː əbˈaʊt hɜː skˈuːl lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: A1桑迪正和奶奶谈她的学校生活

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct prepositions of time.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt pɹˌɛpəzˈɪʃᵊnz ɒv tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 完成他们与时间的正确预设的对话。

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: Hi, Sandy. Tell me about your life at school.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, sˈandi. tˈɛl mˌiː əbˈaʊt jɔː lˈaɪf at skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 嗨，桑迪，你好吗？ 告诉我你在学校的生活

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: Good. Do you play any sport at school?
sentences.ipa: /ɡˈʊd. dˈuː juː plˈeɪ ˈɛni spˈɔːt at skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 不错 你在学校有运动吗？

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: That’s exciting! When is this year’s match?
sentences.ipa: /ðˈats ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ! wˌɛn ɪz ðɪs jˈɪəz mˈaʧ?/
sentences.meaning: 这是令人兴奋的！ 今年的比赛是什么时候？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: the afternoon.
sentences.ipa: /ði ˌɑːftənˈuːn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Would you like to come and watch?
sentences.ipa: /wˌʊd juː lˈaɪk tə kˈʌm and wˈɒʧ?/

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: Of course!
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv kˈɔːs!/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A2 Talk with your partner about your school life, using prepositions of time.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪ tˈuː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl lˈaɪf, jˈuːzɪŋ pɹˌɛpəzˈɪʃᵊnz ɒv tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: A2 跟你的搭档谈谈你的学校生活 用时间的预设

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Adverbs of frequency tell you how often things happen.
sentences.ipa: /ˈadvəːbz ɒv fɹˈiːkwᵊnsi tˈɛl juː hˌaʊ ˈɒfᵊn θˈɪŋz hˈapᵊn./
sentences.meaning: 频率的副词告诉你事情的发生频率。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the graph below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk at ðə ɡɹˈɑːf bɪlˈəʊ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B1 Sandy is writing about how often she and her classmates exercise.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː wˈʌn sˈandi ɪz ɹˈaɪtɪŋ əbˈaʊt hˌaʊ ˈɒfᵊn ʃiː and hɜː klˈɑːsmeɪts ˈɛksəsaɪz./
sentences.meaning: B1 桑迪在写她和同学的锻炼频率。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the graph above.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk at ðə ɡɹˈɑːf əbˈʌv./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then help her complete the notes below.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈɛn hˈɛlp hɜː kəmplˈiːt ðə nˈəʊts bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 那就帮她完成下面的笔记

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We put an adverb of frequency after the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː pˌʊt ɐn ˈadvəːb ɒv fɹˈiːkwᵊnsi ˈɑːftə ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 我们在动词后加了一个频率副词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am always happy.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɐm ˈɔːlweɪz hˈapi./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I do not have much time to play tennis.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ dˈuː nˌɒt hav mˈʌʧ tˈaɪm tə plˈeɪ tˈɛnɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: play tennis.
sentences.ipa: /plˈeɪ tˈɛnɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon loves playing football.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʌvz plˈeɪɪŋ fˈʊtbɔːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: football on the sports field.
sentences.ipa: /fˈʊtbɔːl ˌɒn ðə spˈɔːts fˈiːld./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Amy is a member of the swimming team.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪmi ɪz ɐ mˈɛmbə ɒv ðə swˈɪmɪŋ tˈiːm./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: swims after school.
sentences.ipa: /swˈɪmz ˈɑːftə skˈuːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Daniel does not like basketball.
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl dˈʌz nˌɒt lˈaɪk bˈɑːskɪtbɔːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Kitty dances every day.
sentences.ipa: /kˈɪti dˈɑːnsɪz ˈɛvəɹi dˈeɪ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: an hour.
sentences.ipa: /ɐn ˈaʊə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: at it.
sentences.ipa: /at ɪt./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B2 Write six sentences about your school activities, using each adverb of frequency above once.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː tˈuː ɹˈaɪt sˈɪks sˈɛntᵊnsɪz əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl aktˈɪvɪtiz, jˈuːzɪŋ ˈiːʧ ˈadvəːb ɒv fɹˈiːkwᵊnsi əbˈʌv wˈʌns./
sentences.meaning: B2 写六句关于你的学校活动，使用每个频率高于一次的副词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the following words.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letter groups in bold.
sentences.ipa: /pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃᵊn tə ðə sˈaʊndz ɒv ðə lˈɛtə ɡɹˈuːps ɪn bˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 注意字母组以粗体表示的声音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Read the words below.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ ɹˈiːd ðə wˈɜːdz bɪlˈəʊ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Put each of them in the correct place.
sentences.ipa: /pˌʊt ˈiːʧ ɒv ðˌɛm ɪn ðə kəɹˈɛkt plˈeɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Look at the following pairs of words.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː lˈʊk at ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ pˈɛːz ɒv wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the first word of each pair.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ðə fˈɜːst wˈɜːd ɒv ˈiːʧ pˈɛː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then try to read the second one correctly.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈɛn tɹˈaɪ tə ɹˈiːd ðə sˈɛkᵊnd wˈʌn kəɹˈɛktli./
sentences.meaning: 那就试着正确读第二本

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Practise saying the following phrases.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː pɹˈaktɪs sˈeɪɪŋ ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ fɹˈeɪzɪz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Sandy is reading the school field trip notice for the Grade 7 students.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ sˈandi ɪz ɹˈiːdɪŋ ðə skˈuːl fˈiːld tɹˈɪp nˈəʊtɪs fɔː ðə ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts./
sentences.meaning: 一个桑迪正在读7年级学生的校外旅行通知。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read it with her and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ɪt wɪð hɜː and ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 跟她一起读 回答下面的问题

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Please find more on the school website.
sentences.ipa: /plˈiːz fˈaɪnd mˈɔː ˌɒn ðə skˈuːl wˈɛbsaɪt./
sentences.meaning: 请在学校网站上找到更多信息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What can the Grade 7 students do on the autumn field trip?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt kan ðə ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts dˈuː ˌɒn ði ˈɔːtəm fˈiːld tɹˈɪp?/
sentences.meaning: 1 7年级学生秋季实地考察能做什么？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you like about your field trips?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt jɔː fˈiːld tɹˈɪps?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你喜欢什么 关于你的实地考察？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why?
sentences.ipa: /wˌaɪ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Sandy is listening to Mr Wu talking about one of the field trips.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː sˈandi ɪz lˈɪsənɪŋ tə mˈɪstə wˈuː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt wˈʌn ɒv ðə fˈiːld tɹˈɪps./
sentences.meaning: B Sandy在听吴先生讲一个实地考察

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen to Mr Wu and help Sandy complete her notes.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɪsᵊn tə mˈɪstə wˈuː and hˈɛlp sˈandi kəmplˈiːt hɜː nˈəʊts./
sentences.meaning: 听吴先生的话 帮桑迪完成笔记

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When listening for details, pay attention to some words that help us follow the content, such as in the morning, in the afternoon and then.
sentences.ipa: /wˌɛn lˈɪsənɪŋ fɔː dˈiːteɪlz, pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃᵊn tə sˌʌm wˈɜːdz ðat hˈɛlp ˌʌs fˈɒləʊ ðə kˈɒntɛnt, sˈʌʧ az ɪn ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ, ɪn ði ˌɑːftənˈuːn and ðˈɛn./
sentences.meaning: 在聆听细节时，注意一些帮助我们跟踪内容的文字，比如在上午，下午，然后。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Sandy and her classmates are talking about school field trips.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː sˈandi and hɜː klˈɑːsmeɪts ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt skˈuːl fˈiːld tɹˈɪps./
sentences.meaning: C Sandy和她的同学正在谈论学校的实地考察。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in groups and talk about the topic.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn ɡɹˈuːps and tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt ðə tˈɒpɪk./
sentences.meaning: 分组工作，并讨论这一专题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn bɪlˈəʊ az ɐ mˈɒdᵊl./

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: What do you like about school field trips, Amy?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt skˈuːl fˈiːld tɹˈɪps, ˈeɪmi?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢学校实地考察吗，艾米？

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: I love field trips because I like being outside. It’s nice to get close to nature, and I can enjoy the peace and quiet there.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv fˈiːld tɹˈɪps bɪkˈɒz ˌaɪ lˈaɪk bˈiːɪŋ ˌaʊtsˈaɪd. ˌɪts nˈaɪs tə ɡɛt klˈəʊs tə nˈeɪʧə, and ˌaɪ kan ɪnʤˈɔɪ ðə pˈiːs and kwˈaɪət ðˈɛː./
sentences.meaning: ▁我喜欢野外旅行，因为我喜欢外出。 接近自然是件好事，我可以在那里享受和平和宁静。

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: That’s true. And you, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /ðˈats tɹˈuː. ˌand juː,?/
sentences.meaning: 这是事实。 你呢，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I like the teamwork on the trips. Everybody tries their best to make things better.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ðə tˈiːmwəːk ˌɒn ðə tɹˈɪps. ˈɛvɹɪbɒdi tɹˈaɪz ðɛː bˈɛst tə mˌeɪk θˈɪŋz bˈɛtə./
sentences.meaning: ▁我喜欢旅行中的团队合作▁每个人都尽力让事情变得更好

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Yes, but sometimes field trips are too tiring for me. I like our class duties on Mondays. It feels good to keep our school area clean.
sentences.ipa: /jˈɛs, bˌʌt sˈʌmtaɪmz fˈiːld tɹˈɪps ɑː tˈuː tˈaɪəɹɪŋ fɔː mˌiː. ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ˌaʊə klˈɑːs djˈuːtiz ˌɒn mˈʌndeɪz. ˌɪt fˈiːlz ɡˈʊd tə kˈiːp ˌaʊə skˈuːl ˈɛːɹɪə klˈiːn./
sentences.meaning: ▁是的，但有时实地考察对我来说太累了，我喜欢我们周一的课课，让我们的校区保持清洁感觉很好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Sunshine Middle School newsletter is inviting students to send in articles about their hands-on learning at school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdᵊl skˈuːl njˈuːzlˌɛtə ɪz ɪnvˈaɪtɪŋ stjˈuːdnts tə sˈɛnd ˈɪn ˈɑːtɪkᵊlz əbˈaʊt ðɛː hˌandzˈɒn lˈɜːnɪŋ at skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D阳光中学通讯邀请学生发文章介绍自己在学校的亲身学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Answer the questions below with the information about your school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː wˈʌn ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ði ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃᵊn əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D1 以有关你学校的资料回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What is it?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt ɪz ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 How often does it take place?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː hˌaʊ ˈɒfᵊn dˈʌz ɪt tˈeɪk plˈeɪs?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 When does it take place?
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː wˌɛn dˈʌz ɪt tˈeɪk plˈeɪs?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 How many students take part in it?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː hˌaʊ mˈɛni stjˈuːdnts tˈeɪk pˈɑːt ɪn ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 What do you usually do?
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv wˌɒt dˈuː juː jˈuːʒʊəli dˈuː?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 What can you learn from it?
sentences.ipa: /sˈɪks wˌɒt kan juː lˈɜːn fɹɒm ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D2 Read Sandy’s article about her hands-on learning at school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tˈuː ɹˈiːd sˈandiz ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əbˈaʊt hɜː hˌandzˈɒn lˈɜːnɪŋ at skˈuːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: do different chores.
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː dˈɪfəɹənt ʧˈɔːz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My group works on Mondays.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ ɡɹˈuːp wˈɜːks ˌɒn mˈʌndeɪz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: and I clean the blackboard and empty the bins.
sentences.ipa: /and ˌaɪ klˈiːn ðə blˈakbɔːd and ˈɛmpti ðə bˈɪnz./

sentences.text: one book, one pen, one child and one teacher can change the world. Teachers open the door, but you must enter by yourself. Tell me and I forget, teach me and I may remember, involve me and I learn. The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
